LightningComponentBundle.description: Display an at-a-glance badge with an icon and label for use on record pages or in flows.

property.name: indText
property.label: Label Text
property.description: The text label displayed on the badge.

property.name: indIcon
property.label: Icon
property.description: (Optional) The Lightning Design System icon from https://lightningdesignsystem.com/icons/.

property.name: indAltText
property.label: Icon Alternative Text
property.description: Alternative text for the badge icon for accessibility.

property.name: indIconPosition
property.label: Icon Position
property.description: Position of the icon relative to the label text: start or end.

property.name: indForegroundColor
property.label: Foreground Color
property.description: (Optional) Override the badge icon foreground color.

property.name: indTextColor
property.label: Text Color
property.description: (Optional) Override the badge label text color.
